verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents first-party modular NPM packages, exporter plugins for 3ds Max, Maya and Blender, and official tools such as the Node Material Editor and Inspector. Its core npm package also shows substantial adoption. There is no evidence of an asset store or marketplace of ready-made models, or of a large third-party plugin ecosystem, and one community report says activity is concentrated in Microsoft-run channels. Missing for 10: an asset store or marketplace of ready-made models, a documented third-party plugin/package ecosystem, independent corroboration of ecosystem breadth.

support.subject: As a game developer, a large asset store or package ecosystem gives me ready-made models, tools, and plugins
